# Atomic Bool admission canonical fixture

This source-only fixture uses the maintained pinned compiler recipe over all
seven listed prerequisite/owned theories. Every theory contributes its complete
ORDER and a generated import-only CleanQualification aggregate. The owned
KCheckBoolAdmission package has seven production roots; its production aggregate
and this fixture aggregate define no declarations.

AtomicBoolContracts.lean and CONTRACTS.json are byte-exact copies of the frozen
report literals/pairs at Root Nativec30250d22c. They contain46 independent full
public propositions and the existing three binder-deletion/one receipt-kind
mutation literals, without using an implementation theorem or its inferred type.
The new separate Rust target retains the exact-one-familyConstant occurrence
guard on the actual compiled receipt theorem, then reuses the common Main E2
qualification, meaning digests, original-body/False and exact-mutation checks.
The current E2 helper owner supplies Package.theories and Package.fixture_modules;
this fixture does not change that helper or any existing test.

Actual fresh Lean/fenced Clean execution, successful statement/meaning/closure
mint and the subsequent ordinary default run remain owed. No placeholder pin or
empty census is provided. Prior native execution does not qualify this fixture.
Current KCheck dispatch and Extends are unchanged; integrating the standalone
transaction into them remains a separate obligation. No E7 scope, Choice policy,
self-admission, compiled lineage, quorum or authority claim follows.
